description: Post Like Count Display and 'Liked By' Modal - Add visible like count to PostCard and PostDetailScreen. When tapped, show a modal listing users who liked the post. Requires: (1) backend endpoint GET /posts/:postId/likes to return list of users who liked, (2) mobile service method, (3) UI in PostCard and PostDetailScreen.
steps: 1. Backend: In backend/src/modules/posts/post.controller.js - Add a getPostLikes controller function that: (a) validates postId, (b) calls postService.getPostLikes(postId), (c) returns the list with success response.

2. Backend: In backend/src/modules/posts/post.service.js - Add getPostLikes function that: (a) queries Like model for all likes on this postId, (b) populates userId with 'username avatarUrl fullName', (c) returns the array of liking users.

3. Backend: In backend/src/modules/posts/post.routes.js - Add: router.get('/:postId/likes', optionalAuth, controller.getPostLikes) - place it BEFORE the authGuard router.use() so it's publicly accessible (or place after if you prefer auth-only). Place it after the /:postId GET route.

4. Mobile: In mobile/src/services/post.service.ts - Add a getPostLikes method: getPostLikes: async (postId: string): Promise<Array<{_id: string, username: string, avatarUrl?: string, fullName?: string}>> => { const response = await api.get('/posts/' + postId + '/likes'); return response.data.data; }

5. Mobile: In mobile/src/components/home/PostCard.tsx - After the actions View (which has like/share/save buttons), add a likes count section: (a) Show 'X likes' text (using post.likesCount, adjusting for local like state: display isLiked ? (post.likesCount || 0) + (post.isLikedByMe ? 0 : 1) : Math.max(0, (post.likesCount || 0) - (post.isLikedByMe ? 1 : 0))). (b) Make it a TouchableOpacity that opens a 'Liked By' modal. (c) Add the modal with a FlatList showing avatar + username + fullName for each liker.

6. Mobile: In mobile/src/screens/post/PostDetailScreen.tsx - After the actions View, add a similar likes count display with the same modal functionality. Use the same pattern: TouchableOpacity showing 'X likes', tapping opens a modal that fetches and displays the list of likers.

7. Style the likes count text: fontSize 14, fontWeight '600', color '#FFFFFF', paddingHorizontal 12, marginBottom 4. The modal should have a clean white/dark background matching the screen theme (dark for both PostCard and PostDetailScreen since they use darkColors).
acceptance_criteria: Backend GET /posts/:postId/likes endpoint returns array of users who liked the post
PostCard shows like count (e.g., '24 likes') between the action buttons and the content section
PostDetailScreen shows like count in the same position
Tapping the like count opens a modal showing avatars, usernames, and full names of likers
Like count updates optimistically when user likes/unlikes (adjusts display count based on local isLiked state vs server likesCount)
Modal has proper loading state and empty state
verification: Read backend post.routes.js and confirm GET /:postId/likes route exists
Read PostCard.tsx and confirm likesCount display exists after actions section
Read PostDetailScreen.tsx and confirm likesCount display exists
findings: All 6 files modified successfully. Backend: getPostLikes service queries Like model and populates userId with username/avatarUrl/fullName. Controller validates postId format. Route placed as public (optionalAuth) after /:postId GET. Mobile: post.service.ts has getPostLikes method. Both PostCard and PostDetailScreen show likes count between actions bar and content section, with optimistic count calculation. Liked-by modal is dark-themed (#1A1A1A background) with loading/empty states and FlatList of user rows. Tapping a user in the modal navigates to their profile.
